name: producer-tag
description: Plays an anime-voice producer tag (「マスター！確認してください」, 'Master! Please check this.') when Claude needs your input, or finishes work that took 10 seconds or more.

sound.title: Sound file
sound.description: Path to your own .wav, .mp3, .m4a or .aiff file (up to 4 MB). Leave empty for the default tag.
